messages.subject: Re: Quick "softmax" question
parts:
A user sent me an off-list message on the state of the softmax
analytical derivatives (for speed and arithmetic stability), and
I thought I'd reply to the list.

The current develop branch on GitHub includes the analytic
derivatives for softmax, and also includes:

-- a version of categorical() that uses it,

-- a new distribution categorical_logit() that takes
the log odds params directly, and

-- vectorizing the first argument of categorical() and categorical_logit()
so that you only have to compute the softmax once

What's going to change most from current develop branch to release
of 2.0 (which should be any week now --- we really are closing in on it)
will be how the command-line works (as well as letting our
current patches and pull requests for bug fixes and tweaks trickle through).

- Bob
